title: Normalize P010 source bit depth
summary: Normalize common semiplanar P010 video as 10-bit in the shared source-media contract.
reason: The canonical pixel-format fallback reported p010le as 8-bit when ffprobe omitted explicit bit fields, which could reject valid 10-bit proof fixtures and misstate SourceMediaInfo.
behavior_before: A p010le video stream without bits_per_raw_sample or bits_per_sample normalized to 8-bit.
behavior_after: P010-family semiplanar video streams normalize to 10-bit while explicit positive bit-depth fields retain precedence.
tests_added: The source-media contract recognizes p010le as 10-bit without an explicit raw-depth field.
manual_validation: RED: the focused SourceMediaInfo adapter regression reported p010le as 8-bit instead of 10-bit while preserving an explicit 12-bit value.
GREEN: the focused P010 SourceMediaInfo regression passed and the combined Policy Proof Pack/source-media contract suite passed 30/30 tests.
Focused Ruff passed for the shared contract, Policy Proof Pack tool, and both changed test modules.
rollback_plan: Revert the narrow P010 pixel-format fallback and its contract regression together; no media files, FFmpeg commands, or runtime state are changed.
notes:
Python impact: contract fact normalization only; no dependency, schema, API, FFmpeg command, or filesystem-mutation change. The bit-depth field is not currently consumed by core routing logic.
